name: Sandra
summary: Works 80 % in HR, shares a household with her partner and two kids, has the paper-and-PET pickup subscription and collects points everywhere but rarely redeems them.

context.household: Dual income, partner and two kids (8, 11)

jobs.text: Get rid of paper, PET and aluminium without driving to the collection point
jobs.label: grounded

jobs.text: Feel that the household's effort is worth something
jobs.label: guess

pains.text: Points programmes pay out so little that she forgets about them
pains.label: grounded

pains.text: Little time for neighbourhood engagement next to work and kids
pains.label: guess

objections.text: If I give my shares away, that's my reward gone
objections.label: guess

objections.text: Wants proof that the money really reaches the project, otherwise it's just advertising
objections.label: guess

objections.text: A bakery doubling it sounds like a marketing gimmick
objections.label: guess

speechStyle.notes: Standard German with Swiss words: Quartier, Znüni, Velo, parkieren, Abo.

evidence.claim: Target group: subscribers of the pickup service around Luzern, 30–55, dual-income households, at least 2 people, use points or loyalty programmes
evidence.quote: Doppelverdiener-Haushalte. Mind. 2 Personen, die heute Punkte- oder Treueprogramme aktiv nutzen.
